summary: Verified the SaaS Radar Topics popover scroll fix (ScrollArea h-72) in the admin panel. Logged in as adrian@affilitube.com, opened the SaaS Radar tab, expanded the Topics popover, and validated both scrolling and filter behaviors. Scrolling now works correctly — viewport scrollHeight=4514px, clientHeight=288px, scrollTop reaches 4226 after scrollToBottom, meaning the entire 150-topic list is reachable. Search + checkbox + active chip + prospect-count update flow also works end-to-end.

verified_scenarios.details: 150 topic rows rendered. Radix scroll viewport: scrollHeight=4514, clientHeight=288. After programmatic scroll-to-bottom, scrollTop=4226 (reached bottom). Last topic row 'radar-topic-row-database' becomes visible. Confirms the h-72 fix (vs the broken max-h-72) is effective.

verified_scenarios.scenario: Search + checkbox + active chip + prospect-count update
verified_scenarios.details: Typed 'productivity' into radar-topics-search; list narrowed to 1 row. Clicked the checkbox, closed popover by clicking outside. Active filter chip 'radar-active-topic-productivity' appeared. Prospect count header dropped from 'Prospects · 2,640 results' (unfiltered baseline) to 'Prospects · 1,174 results' — backend filter applied and UI updated.

critical_code_review_comments: SaaSRadarPanel.jsx is 1,196 lines — exceeds the recommended 700-line guideline. Consider splitting filter section (Topics popover, Exclude keywords, Hide platform apps), Stats/Action cards, and Results table into separate child components for maintainability.
Topic popover search is case-insensitive on slug but does not debounce; fine since it is client-side filtering of an already-loaded array, but worth noting if the dataset ever grows.
Minor: line 56 falls back to process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL but uses import.meta.env first — works under CRA/Vite hybrid but is non-standard; not blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The Topics popover scroll bug is fixed. The Radix ScrollArea inside the popover uses h-72 on the parent (line 763 of SaaSRadarPanel.jsx) which gives the Radix viewport its required fixed height. Verified end-to-end via Playwright: scroll reaches bottom (scrollTop=4226 with scrollHeight=4514) and active-filter flow updates prospect count from 2,640 to 1,174 when selecting 'productivity'. Ingest/Enrich buttons were intentionally not exercised (long-running jobs). All other SaaS Radar interactions (filters, search, chip removal) appear functional from inspection.
rca of the issue: Root cause was Radix UI ScrollArea's viewport using h-full w-full, which requires its parent to have a FIXED height. The previous code used Tailwind 'max-h-72' on the ScrollArea — max-height does not establish a definite height for h-full children, so the viewport collapsed to content-height and never overflowed/scrolled. Swapping to 'h-72' gives the ScrollArea a concrete 288px height, which the viewport then fills, enabling the inner content (4514px tall for 150 rows) to scroll. Verified by direct DOM inspection: scrollHeight (4514) > clientHeight (288) and programmatic scrollTop now propagates.
